license.en: Taiwan.md's compilation and text are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Each underlying value follows its publisher's licence (for government data, mainly Taiwan's Open Government Data License v1, which requires naming the original agency).

method.zh-TW: 每個數值都回到發布機構的原始頁面或統計表核對，研究原檔在 reports/research/2026-10/data-hub-r5*.md，附原文逐字。
method.en: Every value was checked against the publisher's own page or statistical table; the research files with verbatim quotes are in reports/research/2026-10/data-hub-r5*.md.

insight.zh-TW: 2019 年底到頂之後起伏往下，比高點少了大約 39 萬人。
insight.en: Past its peak at the end of 2019 and drifting down since, about 390,000 below the high.

insight.zh-TW: 十年少了一半；2024 年到 2025 年一年就少了 2.7 萬人。
insight.en: Half the number of ten years ago, and 27,000 fewer than the year before.

insight.zh-TW: 一位女性一生平均生不到 0.7 個孩子；人口要維持不減大約需要 2.1。
insight.en: A woman has fewer than 0.7 children on average over her lifetime; holding the population steady takes about 2.1.

insight.zh-TW: 2020 年起死亡多於出生，差距一年比一年大；2025 年死亡 20 萬人、出生 10.8 萬人。
insight.en: Deaths have outnumbered births since 2020 and the gap keeps widening: 200,000 deaths against 108,000 births in 2025.

articles: Society/台灣長期照顧制度發展

insight.zh-TW: 2025 年 12 月底跨過 20%，台灣進入超高齡社會；14 歲以下只剩 11.2%。
insight.en: It crossed 20% at the end of December 2025, making Taiwan a super-aged society; under-15s are down to 11.2%.

articles: Society/台灣長期照顧制度發展

insight.zh-TW: 一半的人超過 45.7 歲；原住民族人口的年齡中位數是 34.9 歲，年輕將近 11 歲。
insight.en: Half the population is older than 45.7; for Indigenous peoples the median is 34.9, almost 11 years younger.

articles: Culture/台灣原住民族16族文化地圖

insight.zh-TW: 女性 84.75 歲、男性 77.93 歲；縣市之間差了七歲半，臺北市 83.98 歲、臺東縣 76.49 歲。
insight.en: 84.75 for women and 77.93 for men, with a seven-and-a-half-year gap between Taipei (83.98) and Taitung (76.49).

articles: Society/台灣長期照顧制度發展

insight.zh-TW: 比前一年少 15.2%；其中 3,305 對是同性伴侶，18.5% 有一方是外籍或陸港澳配偶。
insight.en: Down 15.2% on the year; 3,305 were same-sex couples, and in 18.5% one partner was foreign or from China, Hong Kong or Macau.

insight.zh-TW: 亞洲第一個同婚合法化的國家；累計數是本站把戶政司每年的登記數相加，每一年都是女性伴侶比男性多。
insight.en: Taiwan was the first in Asia to legalise same-sex marriage. The cumulative total is our sum of the annual registrations; women couples outnumber men every year.

insight.zh-TW: 陸港澳配偶 39.4 萬人、外籍配偶 22.9 萬人，以女性為多；陸港澳部分計的是申請證件人數。
insight.en: 393,700 from China, Hong Kong and Macau and 229,000 from other countries, mostly women; the mainland figure counts permit applicants.

articles: Culture/族群（閩南客家原住民外省新住民）

insight.zh-TW: 十年增加近五成，印尼、越南、菲律賓三國占九成一；數字是本站把勞動部資料集各國籍列相加。
insight.en: Up almost 50% in ten years, with Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines making up 91%; the total is our sum of the ministry's rows by nationality.

articles: Society/台灣長期照顧制度發展

insight.zh-TW: 占總人口 2.7%，法定 16 族，阿美族 23.5 萬人最多；2024 年一年多了 2.3 萬人，通報沒有說明原因。
insight.en: 2.7% of the population across 16 recognised peoples, the Amis largest at 235,000; numbers jumped by 23,000 in 2024 for reasons the ministry has not explained.

articles: Culture/台灣原住民族16族文化地圖
Society/台灣原住民族土地正義與傳統領域

agency.zh-TW: 行政院主計總處（家庭收支調查）
agency.en: DGBAS (Survey of Family Income and Expenditure)

insight.zh-TW: 1991 年一戶 4.16 人，現在不到 2.7 人。
insight.en: Down from 4.16 people per household in 1991 to under 2.7 today.

title.zh-TW: 大學入學生源（高三學生數）

insight.zh-TW: 十年少了 11 萬人；大專校院學生從 133.2 萬人降到 105.7 萬人，校數五年從 152 所減為 139 所。
insight.en: 110,000 fewer in ten years; tertiary enrolment fell from 1.33 million to 1.06 million, and the number of institutions from 152 to 139 in five years.

articles: Society/台灣高等教育擴張與退場

agency.zh-TW: 行政院主計總處（家庭收支調查）
agency.en: DGBAS (Survey of Family Income and Expenditure)

insight.zh-TW: 所得最低的兩成家庭是 77.17%，最高的兩成是 91.46%；租屋的家庭占 7.62%。
insight.en: 77.17% for the poorest fifth of households and 91.46% for the richest; 7.62% of households rent.

insight.zh-TW: 中位數所得的家庭買一間中位數住宅（980 萬元），每月要拿可支配所得的四成三繳房貸。
insight.en: A median-income household buying a median home (NT$9.8 million) would spend 43% of disposable income on the mortgage each month.

title.zh-TW: 家庭所得五等分位差距
title.en: Household income gap, top vs bottom fifth

agency.zh-TW: 行政院主計總處（家庭收支調查）
agency.en: DGBAS (Survey of Family Income and Expenditure)

insight.zh-TW: 最高兩成家庭的可支配所得是最低兩成的 6.17 倍；扣掉每戶人數差異後是 3.73 倍。家庭可支配所得中位數 101.8 萬元。
insight.en: The richest fifth of households have 6.17 times the disposable income of the poorest fifth, or 3.73 times per person; the median household has NT$1.018 million.

insight.zh-TW: 失業 40.5 萬人，就業 1,164 萬人，勞動力參與率 59.59%。
insight.en: 405,000 unemployed and 11.64 million employed, with labour force participation at 59.59%.

insight.zh-TW: 一半的受僱者一年領不到 54.6 萬元，平均每月約 4.55 萬；女性 51.2 萬、男性 58.5 萬。2025 年的數字 11 月底發布。
insight.en: Half of employees earn less than NT$546,000 a year, about NT$45,500 a month; women NT$512,000, men NT$585,000. The 2025 figure is due in late November.

insight.zh-TW: 時薪 196 元；勞動部已公布 2027 年起調為月薪 30,900 元、時薪 205 元，連續 11 年調升。
insight.en: NT$196 an hour; the ministry has announced NT$30,900 a month and NT$205 an hour from 2027, the eleventh rise in a row.

agency.zh-TW: 勞動部（依主計總處薪資統計）

insight.zh-TW: 工業及服務業受僱員工，其中正常工時 160.1 小時；工業部門 175.1 小時比服務業長。
insight.en: For employees in industry and services, 160.1 of them regular hours; industry works longer, at 175.1 hours.

insight.zh-TW: 2,396 萬人在保；2010 年起都維持在 99% 以上。
insight.en: 23.96 million people insured, above 99% every year since 2010.

insight.zh-TW: 加上中醫與牙醫是每萬人 35 人；護理人員每萬人 84.1 人。
insight.en: 35 per 10,000 including Chinese medicine practitioners and dentists; 84.1 nurses per 10,000.

insight.zh-TW: 占全部死亡的 27.5%，連續 44 年是十大死因第一名；肺癌、肝癌、結腸直腸癌連續 22 年排前三。
insight.en: 27.5% of all deaths and the leading cause for 44 years running; lung, liver and colorectal cancer have been the top three for 22 years.

articles: Society/台灣公共衛生與防疫體系

insight.zh-TW: 2013 年以來最高，比第二高的 2021 年多出 2 個百分點；主計總處 8 月預測 2026 年再到 11.05%。
insight.en: The highest since at least 2013, two points above 2021; in August the statistics office forecast 11.05% for 2026.

insight.zh-TW: 以新臺幣計是 28.7 兆元；十年之間以美元計多了七成以上，其中一年就多了約 1,209 億美元。
insight.en: NT$28.7 trillion in local currency; up more than 70% in dollar terms over ten years, about US$121 billion of it in the last year alone.

insight.zh-TW: 十年多了 16,735 美元；這是總產出除以人口，跟一般人的薪水是兩件事（見社會類的薪資中位數）。
insight.en: Up US$16,735 in ten years. This is output divided by population, which is a different thing from what a typical worker earns (see the median wage under Society).

insight.zh-TW: 經濟成長創新高的同一年，物價漲幅回落到 1.66%。
insight.en: In the same year growth hit a record, inflation eased back to 1.66%.

insight.zh-TW: 一年增加 34.9%，進口也同時創新高；全年出超 1,571.4 億美元，同樣是紀錄。
insight.en: Up 34.9% in a year, with imports also at a record; the trade surplus of US$157.1 billion was a record too.

articles: Economy/台灣外貿與全球供應鏈

title.zh-TW: 對美國出口占總出口比重

period.zh-TW: 同年對中國大陸與香港
period.en: China and Hong Kong, same year

insight.zh-TW: 美國超過中國大陸與香港，成為台灣最大的出口市場，財政部說這是 26 年來第一次。
insight.en: The US overtook China and Hong Kong as Taiwan's largest export market, which the Ministry of Finance says is the first time in 26 years.

articles: Economy/台灣外貿與全球供應鏈

insight.zh-TW: 同一則公告註明，外資持有的台灣股票、債券與新臺幣存款折合 19,272 億美元，約是外匯存底的 3.2 倍。
insight.en: The same release notes that foreign holdings of Taiwanese stocks, bonds and NT dollar deposits equal US$1.93 trillion, about 3.2 times the reserves.

insight.zh-TW: 九個月多了 62 兆元；台積電一家的發行市值 64.3 兆元，約占四成一（本站以證交所兩個數字相除）。
insight.en: Up NT$62 trillion in nine months. TSMC alone is worth NT$64.3 trillion, about 41% of the total (our division of two exchange figures).

insight.zh-TW: 十年漲到約 3.5 倍；2026 年 9 月底已收在 47,940 點。
insight.en: About 3.5 times its level ten years earlier; by the end of September 2026 it had closed at 47,940.

insight.zh-TW: 一年增加 89.5%，其中電腦及附屬單元多了 986.5 億美元；跟電子零組件合計，占總出口七成四。
insight.en: Up 89.5% in a year, with computers and peripherals alone adding US$98.7 billion; together with electronic components it makes up 74% of all exports.

articles: Economy/台灣外貿與全球供應鏈

agency.zh-TW: 工研院產業科技國際策略發展所
agency.en: ITRI Industry, Science and Technology International Strategy Center

insight.zh-TW: 年增 22.7%，製造占約三分之二；這是工研院的估計值，今年已經上修過幾次。
insight.en: Up 22.7%, with manufacturing about two-thirds of it. This is ITRI's estimate, revised upward several times this year.

title.zh-TW: 台積電全球晶圓代工市占
title.en: TSMC's share of global foundry revenue

insight.zh-TW: 分母是全球前十大晶圓代工廠的營收，不含英特爾、三星這類自己做晶片的公司自用的產能。
insight.en: Measured against the revenue of the world's top ten foundries, excluding chipmakers' in-house capacity.

title.en: R&D spending as share of GDP

agency.zh-TW: 國家科學及技術委員會

insight.zh-TW: 全國研發經費首度破兆（10,493 億元），其中八成六由企業出資。
insight.en: National R&D spending passed NT$1 trillion for the first time (NT$1.049 trillion), 86% of it funded by business.

title.zh-TW: 個人上網率（12 歲以上）

insight.zh-TW: 連續幾年卡在八成七左右之後，第一次突破九成；家戶連網率 93.4%。
insight.en: After several years stuck around 87%, it passed 90% for the first time; 93.4% of households are connected.

articles: Technology/台灣5G網路建設與數位轉型

title.zh-TW: 網路族行動支付使用率
title.en: Mobile payment use among internet users

insight.zh-TW: 第一次過半；分母是會上網的人，不是全體人口。
insight.en: Above half for the first time; the base is people who use the internet, not the whole population.

title.en: Natural gas share of power generation

insight.zh-TW: 燃氣已經取代燃煤成為最大電源；燃煤從 45.9% 降到 35.3%，全年總發電量 2,897 億度。
insight.en: Gas has replaced coal as the largest source; coal fell from 45.9% to 35.3%, out of 289.7 billion kWh generated in the year.

articles: Nature/台灣氣候危機與淨零轉型

insight.zh-TW: 十年從 127 億度增加到 386 億度，主力從水力換成太陽光電（43.4%）與風力。
insight.en: From 12.7 to 38.6 billion kWh in ten years, with the mainstay shifting from hydro to solar (43.4%) and wind.

articles: Nature/台灣氣候危機與淨零轉型

insight.zh-TW: 2025 年全年還有 1.1%，因為最後一座核電廠到年中才停機；全年歸零要從 2026 年算起。
insight.en: Still 1.1% for 2025 because the last plant ran until mid-year; a full year at zero starts in 2026.

articles: Nature/台灣氣候危機與淨零轉型

insight.zh-TW: 扣掉碳匯後淨排放 251.4 百萬公噸，比 2005 年基準少 6.59%；製造部門占一半。清冊每年會回頭修正。
insight.en: Net of carbon sinks, 251.4 Mt, 6.59% below the 2005 baseline; manufacturing is half of the total. Each year's inventory revises earlier years.

articles: Nature/台灣氣候危機與淨零轉型

agency.zh-TW: 農業部林業及自然保育署

insight.zh-TW: 森林面積 219.7 萬公頃，其中 41.5 萬公頃長在法定林地以外。
insight.en: 2.197 million hectares of forest, of which 415,000 hectares grow outside designated forest land.

title.zh-TW: 颱風平均每年侵台個數

insight.zh-TW: 115 年間共 382 個颱風侵襲台灣，八月最多。
insight.en: 382 typhoons struck Taiwan over 115 years, most often in August.

insight.zh-TW: 其中特有種 9,881 種，約占一成五；這是名錄資料庫的即時計數，含外來種，會隨更新變動。
insight.en: 9,881 of them, about 15%, are endemic. This is a live count from the catalogue database, including introduced species, and changes as it is updated.

insight.zh-TW: 包含台灣本島、澎湖、金門、馬祖與東沙等離島。
insight.en: Includes the main island of Taiwan plus Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu, Dongsha and other outlying islands.

articles: Geography/台灣島嶼地理特色與形成

insight.zh-TW: 東亞第一高峰；一座三萬多平方公里的島，從海平面到將近四千公尺。
insight.en: The highest peak in East Asia: an island of some 36,000 km² that climbs from sea level to almost 4,000 metres.

insight.zh-TW: 是世界平均的 2.5 倍；但雨集中在梅雨與颱風季、河短流急，水留不太住。
insight.en: Two and a half times the world average, but it falls mostly in the plum-rain and typhoon seasons on short, steep rivers, so little of it stays.

articles: Geography/台灣水庫與水資源管理
Technology/半導體用水與台灣水資源

insight.zh-TW: 選舉人 1,955 萬人，投票 1,405 萬人。
insight.en: 19.55 million eligible voters, 14.05 million of whom voted.

articles: Society/台灣政治環境與選舉制度

insight.zh-TW: 區域 73 席、不分區 34 席、原住民 6 席；不分區依政黨票比例分配。
insight.en: 73 constituency seats, 34 party-list seats and 6 Indigenous seats; party-list seats are shared out by party vote.

articles: Society/台灣政治環境與選舉制度

insight.zh-TW: 列為「自由」；政治權利 38／40、公民自由 55／60。
insight.en: Rated Free: political rights 38/40, civil liberties 55/60.

insight.zh-TW: 分數從 77.04 降到 75.44，名次掉了四名。
insight.en: The score fell from 77.04 to 75.44, a drop of four places.

insight.zh-TW: 1949 年 5 月 19 日宣告、20 日起實施，到 1987 年 7 月 15 日解嚴；九年後台灣第一次直選總統。
insight.en: Declared on 19 May 1949 and in force from the 20th until it was lifted on 15 July 1987; nine years later Taiwan held its first direct presidential election.

agency.zh-TW: 文化部（資料來源：文化資產局）
agency.en: Ministry of Culture (Bureau of Cultural Heritage)

insight.zh-TW: 另有歷史建築 1,786 處、文化景觀 79 處、考古遺址 58 處，數的是已在文資系統登錄的件數。
insight.en: Plus 1,786 historic buildings, 79 cultural landscapes and 58 archaeological sites, counting entries registered in the heritage database.

articles: Culture/台灣傳統工藝與無形文化資產

insight.en: A high of 348 in 2022 and 2023, then five fewer in 2024.

agency.zh-TW: 文化部統計處（原始資料：國家圖書館 ISBN 中心）
agency.en: Ministry of Culture (from the National Central Library ISBN Center)

insight.zh-TW: 2020 年到 2021 年從 3.5 萬種跳到 5.8 萬種，疑似統計口徑改變，跨這兩年比較要小心。
insight.en: The count jumped from 35,000 to 58,000 between 2020 and 2021, apparently a change in how it is counted, so compare across those years with care.

period.zh-TW: 2015 年底（最新一次全國統計）

insight.zh-TW: 道教占 78.5%、佛教 19.3%；另有教會（堂）3,280 座。這是內政部能找到的最新年度，現況請以全國宗教資訊網為準。
insight.en: 78.5% Taoist and 19.3% Buddhist, alongside 3,280 churches. This is the latest year the ministry has published; check its religion portal for current figures.

title.en: Taiwanese films' share of cinema admissions

insight.zh-TW: 2020、2021 年衝到兩成以上，是疫情讓好萊塢片停映的那兩年；2024 年全國觀影 2,335 萬人次。
insight.en: It jumped above 20% in 2020 and 2021, the years the pandemic halted Hollywood releases; total admissions in 2024 were 23.4 million.

title.en: Rice eaten per person per year

insight.zh-TW: 二十年少了 6.2 公斤，2023 年的 42.1 公斤是歷史新低；農業部把外送讓自己煮飯變少列為原因之一。
insight.en: 6.2 kg less than twenty years ago; 2023's 42.1 kg was the lowest on record. The ministry cites food delivery, which means less home cooking, as one reason.

title.en: Meat supply per person per year

insight.zh-TW: 跟穀類（87.6 公斤）幾乎一樣多，是白米的兩倍；蔬菜 108.8、水果 104.3 公斤最多。
insight.en: Almost the same as cereals (87.6 kg) and twice the rice; vegetables (108.8 kg) and fruit (104.3 kg) top the list.

insight.zh-TW: 1992 年跌破四成後，近二十年都在三成上下；吃進去的熱量，七成來自進口。
insight.en: Below 40% since 1992 and around 30% for two decades: seven in ten calories eaten come from imports.

agency.zh-TW: 台灣高速鐵路公司（114 年年報）
agency.en: Taiwan High Speed Rail Corporation (2025 annual report)

insight.zh-TW: 平均每天約 22.5 萬人次，座位利用率 71.59%。
insight.en: About 225,000 trips a day, with 71.59% of seats filled.

agency.zh-TW: 臺北市政府主計處（依交通局統計）

insight.zh-TW: 全年 7.7 億人次，比前一年多 3.7%；台北車站一站每天進出 30 萬人次。
insight.en: 770 million trips a year, up 3.7%; Taipei Main Station alone sees 300,000 entries and exits a day.

agency.zh-TW: 交通部觀光署（資料來源：內政部移民署）

insight.zh-TW: 日本旅客 148 萬人次最多；同年國人出國 1,894 萬人次，是來台人數的 2.2 倍。
insight.en: Japan sent the most visitors, 1.48 million; the same year residents made 18.94 million trips abroad, 2.2 times as many.

period.zh-TW: 2024 年夏季奧運（以「中華台北」名義參賽）

insight.zh-TW: 金牌是李洋、王齊麟的羽球男雙，以及林郁婷的拳擊女子 57 公斤級。
insight.en: The golds came from Lee Yang and Wang Chi-lin in men's doubles badminton and Lin Yu-ting in women's 57 kg boxing.
